name: KNOWN GAP: a year-only silent side still welds to a season-3 cluster

source.test: KNOWN GAP: a year-only silent side still welds to a season-3 cluster

why: The same shape as the case above with one difference: the silent side carries 2026-01-01, the string seven extractors mint out of a bare year, so it declares a year and no day. The date rule blocks on a DISAGREEMENT and a cluster that declares nothing disagrees with nothing, so the two weld. `expect` below is what the store does TODAY, pinned deliberately rather than hidden; see `knownGap` for the answer the works give.

expect.knownGap: anilist:2492 is season 2 and anilist:2493 is season 3, so the right answer is two clusters and `apart`. Closing it by treating silence as a mismatch is the rule already refused for seasons, measured at one wrong weld stopped per 37 correct merges destroyed, so the gap is accepted until a mechanism exists that costs less. A replacement store that splits these two is BETTER than the one this corpus was extracted from: change the case, do not weaken it.
